# Visualization of $c_k$ for different N and $k_{max}$.

The system size can be chosen. In the first plot also x is a parameter.

```{r}
N_value <- 220 # 10:30:1000
x_value <- 3 # 1, 2, 3 or 4

plot_data <- log_c[log_c$N == N_value & log_c$x == x_value, ]

xyplot(c_k ~ k | family,
       data = plot_data,
       xlab = "k",
       ylab = expression(c[k]),
       main = paste("Plot for the coefficients as a function of k, (N =", N_value, "x = ", x_value, ")"),
       prepanel = function(x, y, ...) {
         list(
           xlim = c(0, max(x)),
           ylim = range(y)
         )
       },
       scales = list(
         x = list(relation = "free"),
         y = list(relation = "same"),
         alternating = FALSE,
         tck = c(1, 0)
       ),
       panel = function(x, y, subscripts, ...) {
         panel.xyplot(x, y, ...)

         k_max <- unique(plot_data$kmax[subscripts])

         panel.text(
           x = mean(range(x)) / 2,
           y = 0.9,
           labels =  bquote(k[max] == .(k_max)),
           pos = 3,
           cex = 0.8
         )
       })
```

```{r}
N_value <- 220 # 10:30:1000

plot_data <- dev_c[dev_c$N == N_value, ]

plot_data$x <- factor(
  plot_data$x,
  levels = sort(unique(plot_data$x))
)

levs <- levels(plot_data$x)

strip_labels <- as.expression(
  lapply(levs, function(l) bquote(x == .(as.numeric(l))))
)

xyplot(c_k ~ k | x,
       data = plot_data,
       layout = c(5, 2),
       as.table = TRUE,
       xlab = "k",
       ylab = expression(c[k]),
       main = bquote("Coefficients as a function of k, (N = " * .(N_value) * ", " * k[max] * " = N/x)"),
       strip = strip.custom(factor.levels = strip_labels),
       prepanel = function(x, y, ...) {
         list(xlim = c(0, max(x)), ylim = range(y))
       },
       scales = list(
         x = list(relation = "free"),
         y = list(relation = "same"),
         alternating = FALSE,
         tck = c(1, 0)
       ),
       panel = function(x, y, subscripts, ...) {
         panel.xyplot(x, y, ...)
         k_max <- unique(plot_data$kmax[subscripts])
         panel.text(
           x = mean(range(x)) / 2,
           y = 0.85,
           labels = bquote(k[max] == .(k_max)),
           pos = 3,
           cex = 0.8
         )
       })
```

```{r}
N_value <- 220 # 10:30:1000

plot_data <- pow_c[pow_c$N == N_value, ]

plot_data$x <- factor(
  plot_data$x,
  levels = sort(unique(plot_data$x))
)

xyplot(c_k ~ k | x,
       data = plot_data,
       xlab = "k",
       ylab = expression(c[k]),
       main = bquote("Coefficients as a function of k, (N = " * .(N_value) * ", " * k[max] * " = N^x)"),
       strip = function(which.given, which.panel, var.name, factor.levels, ...) {
         if (which.given == 1) {
           panel_number <- which.panel[1]
           grid::grid.text(
             bquote(x == .(as.numeric(factor.levels[panel_number])))
           )
         } else {
           strip.default(which.given, which.panel, var.name, factor.levels, ...)
         }
       },
       as.table = TRUE,
       prepanel = function(x, y, ...) {
         list(
           xlim = c(0, max(x)),
           ylim = range(y)
         )
       },
       scales = list(
         x = list(relation = "free"),
         y = list(relation = "same"),
         alternating = FALSE,
         tck = c(1, 0)
       ),
       panel = function(x, y, subscripts, ...) {
         panel.xyplot(x, y, ...)

         k_max <- unique(plot_data$kmax[subscripts])

         panel.text(
           x = mean(range(x)) / 2,
           y = 0.7,
           labels =  bquote(k[max] == .(k_max)),
           pos = 3,
           cex = 0.8
         )
       })
```
